questions.qtext: Which of the following options is incorrect in reference to matrix method of structure analysis?

options.text: Elements of leading diagonal of stiffness matrix can be negative
Elements of main diagonal of flexibility matrix are always positive.
Flexibility matrix and its transpose are equal.
Stiffness matrix is a symmetric matrix.

questions.solution:
(a)
• Flexibility stiffnes matrix is equal to its transpose (A′ = A symmetric matrix) as it is a square matrix and its elements are symmetrical about main diagonal.
• Elements of main diagonal (leading diagonal) of stiffness/flexibility matrix are always positive.
